Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
7:16 PM

The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue-Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an I-card. The site's notice from May 29, 2023 says the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries are closed for renovation until further notice. That notice may be out of date, so check before you go.
